A '''Roll of Vellum''' is a rare crafting material.  It is used in the crafting of certain armor sets.

==Acquisition==
* Purchased from [[rare material trader]]s.
* Select [[artisan]]s will craft one Roll of Vellum for 5 [[Wood Plank]]s, 5 [[Pile of Glittering Dust|Piles of Glittering Dust]] and 20 {{gold}}.
* [[Expert Salvage Kit|Expert salvaged]] from:
** Armor crafted with Rolls of Vellum.
** See [[:Category:Contains vellum]] for other items.
* No [[creature]]s currently appear to [[drop]] [[:Category:Drops vellum|Rolls of Vellum]].
* Can be found in [[Hidden Treasure]]s.
